cleaner.label: rustup cache
cleaner.description: Downloaded and temporary rustup files. Does not touch installed toolchains or settings.

option.label: Components downloaded by rustup
option.description: Removes the toolchain and component archives left in rustup's downloads folder.
option.warning: Close rustup before cleaning: an update in progress would fail. Components are re-downloaded on the next `rustup update` or `rustup component add`.

option.label: rustup temporary files
option.description: Removes the temporary files left by rustup installs and updates.
option.warning: Close rustup before cleaning: an update in progress would fail.
